title: Loop runtime status file (loop-status.json)
description: workspace/memory/.monitor/loop-status.json. Single writer = loop control CLI (aidlc/scripts/loop_control.py via aidlc.py loop-*). Reader = dashboard backend (GET /api/v1/control, SSE topic 'control'). Written atomically (temp file in the same directory -> os.replace), UTF-8, no BOM. The dashboard never writes this file. ADR-004 §1·§4, 20 §5 F5. Semantics of each field: loop-cli.md.

run_id.description: New random id per loop-start (uuid4 hex, lowercase, 32 chars).

state.description: Actual session state. running = executing cycles; paused = inside wait-resume (between repeated wait-resume calls too); ended = loop finished (see ended_reason).

baseline_seq.description: .control.json seq observed at loop-start (0 if the control file was missing or broken). Only control requests with seq > baseline_seq apply to this run.

iterations_done.description: Completed cycles reported by the last loop-check / loop-end. Invariant (checked by the writer, not expressible here): 0 <= iterations_done <= iterations_total.

heartbeat_at.description: Last write by any loop-* subcommand (wait-resume also every 30 s). RFC 3339 UTC.

paused_since.description: Start of the current pause episode. Set by the first wait-resume of an episode, kept across repeated wait-resume calls, cleared to null on resume. Not null iff state == paused (also kept when state becomes ended with pause_timeout).

ended_reason.description: Why the loop ended. null unless state == ended.
